data.rationale: The proposal gets the same cross-site procedure in the right order (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then a mail draft) with the right subject and body template, and its recipient_email/recipient_name split is a reasonable reading of {client}. It has two flaws. It ends with "Send" even though the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard, and the parenthetical note about Discard doesn't fix that. It also adds an unsupported {code} field, and it never says that the To address is {client}@example.com. A faithful automation would risk sending the email and would need guesses to fill in some details.
